agents.mission: Own incident state, validate handoffs, route work, package evidence, and publish verified case memory.
agents.handoff_condition: Route only schema-valid artifacts, preserve actor boundaries, and publish memory only after terminal verification.

agents.mission: Collect only allowlisted experiment facts, immutable hashes, configuration and run evidence.
agents.handoff_condition: Evidence validates and excluded or immutable data remains unread or unchanged.

agents.mission: Infer bounded, falsifiable hypotheses from explicit evidence and gaps.
forbidden: treat gaps or memory as facts
agents.handoff_condition: Every claim cites evidence_id and carries confidence, contradictions, and falsification criteria.

agents.mission: Turn one evidence-backed hypothesis into a one-variable, budgeted, reversible experiment.
agents.handoff_condition: Plan changes exactly one allowlisted field and defines success, budget, forbidden changes, approval, and rollback.

agents.mission: Apply an approved plan only inside a fresh restricted sandbox and record raw outputs and hashes.
agents.handoff_condition: Run artifact records changed paths, hashes, command, approval timing, exit status, and sandbox boundary.

agents.mission: Independently recompute postconditions, enforce immutable-file policy, verify trace, and decide closure or rollback.
agents.handoff_condition: RESOLVED requires an independently passing postcondition, unchanged protected hashes, approval-before-run, and valid trace.
